answers.core: There is currently no way to access these buffers without modifying the engine, so you cannot actually build this as an add-on for the asset library.
answers.workaround: You can access the normals + roughness buffer through spatial shaders but this requires you to set up a full screen quad and it becomes really difficult to stack post-processing effects, which I believe is exactly what the CompositorEffect API aims to solve.
